newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks seen stagnating after recent rise.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks seen stagnating after recent rise.

text.p: Sri Lankan stocks are seen taking a breather on Wednesday after rising in recent days mainly on buying by local institutions, brokers said.
"We're looking at a flat day. The market's gone up quite a bit and one of these days the trend has to die off," said Rajiv Casiechitty, manager of research at CT Smith Stockbrokers.

"I would have expected people to wait out the election and the power crisis unless there is bargain buying," he added. "But at these levels there are no bargains unless you take a very long-term view."
